name: Gulf / US–Iran war
value: US–Iran strikes 18 Nov; mines off Hormuz 20 Nov
summary: US struck Qeshm and Iran fired at Kuwait and Bahrain on 18 Nov; Iran says tankers hit its mines off Hormuz on 19–20 Nov
state: On 18 Nov a US strike hit a missile launch site on Qeshm Island, and Kuwait and Bahrain said they intercepted Iranian drone attacks (Al Jazeera). Iran's navy said on 20 Nov that two tankers caught fire after hitting mines in a prohibited zone east of Hormuz (Anadolu). Qatar said on 20 Nov that negotiations remain the best route, but no ceasefire was found (Gulf News). Active strikes between states and attacks on shipping keep the Alert.
for_you: FCDO advises against travel to parts of the Gulf region; check its travel advice before any trip and follow local authority alerts if you are there.
rubric_hit: Active strikes between states and attacks on Gulf shipping = Alert

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Kuwait reports drone attacks as Iran, US trade attacks on Qeshm and Bahrain
Anadolu — 2 oil tankers catch fire after hitting mines east of Strait of Hormuz: Iranian army

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
